evals.prompt: --dry-run: resolve all chain steps and verify each skill exists
evals.expected_output: chain.yaml parses successfully; exactly 6 steps in order (sdd-capture, sdd-spec, sdd-decompose, sdd-harden, sdd-execute, sdd-verify); each step's skill resolves to an existing SKILL.md; precondition status values are valid schema stages; no side effects.
expectations: chain.yaml has name: sdd-run
chain.yaml lists exactly 6 steps
step 1 skill is sdd-capture
step 2 skill is sdd-spec
step 3 skill is sdd-decompose
step 4 skill is sdd-harden
step 5 skill is sdd-execute
step 6 skill is sdd-verify
each skill resolves to ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md
precondition statuses are valid schema values: null, draft, spec, hardened, ready, executing
sdd-harden step is marked human_gated: true
SKILL.md documents --dry-run semantics

evals.prompt: Run the full SDD chain for my notification-service feature
evals.expected_output: sdd-run orchestrates the chain: reads current feature status, enters at the correct step, delegates to the appropriate child skill (sdd-capture → sdd-spec → sdd-decompose → sdd-harden → sdd-execute → sdd-verify), and pauses at human-gated transitions.
expectations: SKILL.md triggers when a user runs any of the four entry commands or when the chain must resume
SKILL.md routes based on the current WP status frontmatter field
SKILL.md delegates to child skills rather than reimplementing their logic

evals.prompt: Continue where we left off on the payment-gateway feature
evals.expected_output: sdd-run reads the current WP status: field, identifies the next actionable step in the chain, and resumes at that step by invoking the appropriate child skill.
expectations: SKILL.md resume mid-chain: reads current WP status and resumes at the next actionable step
SKILL.md status hardened causes sdd-run to present the human gate before advancing
SKILL.md status archived is terminal — sdd-run halts with a clear message

evals.prompt: Fix the bug in the authentication middleware.
evals.expected_output: sdd-run should NOT trigger — this is a direct bug-fix request, not a request to run the SDD chain. The skill is not applicable.
expectations: SKILL.md trigger is specific: invoked when a user runs /spec /plan /implement /verify or when the chain must resume from a known WP stage
A direct bug-fix request is outside the trigger surface of sdd-run

evals.prompt: Resume the SDD chain for wp-03-notifications which is at status: archived
evals.expected_output: sdd-run HALTS with a clear message: archived is a terminal status. No child skill is dispatched, no status fields are mutated.
expectations: SKILL.md status archived is terminal — chain complete; never auto-resumed
SKILL.md never attempts to resume from an archived WP
SKILL.md --dry-run has no side effects and would also report archived as terminal
